milestone: Initial delegated-power period began.
scope: Commission powers to adopt delegated acts under Articles 6, 7, 11, 43, 47, 51, 52 and 53 for five years.
note: Article 97(2) confers the powers for five years from 1 August 2024.

milestone: Regulation entered into force.
scope: Entry into force of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689, twenty days after publication in the Official Journal.
note: Official timeline lists 01 Aug 2024 as entry into force. © European Union.

milestone: Member States' Article 77 authorities list due.
scope: Public authorities or bodies supervising or enforcing Union law protecting fundamental rights were to be identified and made public.
note: Three months after entry into force.

milestone: Chapters I and II started to apply.
scope: General provisions, including Article 4 AI literacy, and prohibited AI practices in Article 5 as then in force.
note: The Commission timeline states general provisions/AI literacy and prohibitions apply from this date; the later Omnibus adds a new prohibition applying in December 2026.

milestone: Commission published guidelines on prohibited AI practices.
scope: Article 5 prohibitions; practical guidance under Article 96.
note: The page is dated 04 February 2025 and describes non-binding Commission interpretation.

milestone: Commission published guidelines on the AI-system definition.
scope: Article 3(1) definition of an AI system; practical guidance under Article 96(1)(f).
note: Official Digital Strategy printable PDF for the Commission's AI-system-definition guidelines.

milestone: GPAI code-of-practice readiness deadline.
scope: Codes of practice for GPAI obligations in Articles 53 and 55 were to be ready at the latest by this date.
note: Final GPAI Code was received by the Commission on 2025-07-10 and approved on 2025-08-01.

milestone: GPAI provider workshop held during Code drafting.
scope: General-purpose AI Code of Practice drafting process.
note: The Commission's Code drafting timeline lists a GPAI provider workshop on July 2 2025.

milestone: GPAI Code closing plenary held.
scope: General-purpose AI Code of Practice drafting process.
note: The Commission's Code drafting timeline lists a closing plenary on July 3 2025.

milestone: Commission received final GPAI Code of Practice.
scope: Voluntary compliance tool for GPAI transparency, copyright, safety and security obligations.
note: Official page states the Code is designed to help industry comply with GPAI rules applying from 2025-08-02.

milestone: Commission published guidelines for providers of GPAI models.
scope: Guidance for providers of general-purpose AI models on obligations taking effect on 2025-08-02.
note: Publication page dated 18 July 2025.

milestone: Commission and AI Board approved the GPAI Code as adequate.
scope: Adequacy assessment for voluntary demonstration of compliance with GPAI obligations.
note: The Commission and AI Board confirmed the Code is an adequate voluntary tool.

milestone: First annual Commission assessment cycle began.
scope: Annual assessment of whether Annex III and Article 5 need amendment, until the end of the delegated-power period.
note: Date calculated as the first anniversary following entry into force.

milestone: Commission serious-incident reporting guidance deadline.
scope: Dedicated guidance to facilitate compliance with serious-incident reporting obligations.
note: Article 73(7) sets the deadline and requires regular assessment.

milestone: First Member State resources report due.
scope: Member States report to the Commission on financial and human resources of national competent authorities; every two years thereafter.
note: Repeats every two years after this date.

milestone: GPAI, governance, notified-body and penalty provisions started to apply.
scope: Chapter III Section 4, Chapter V, Chapter VII, Chapter XII and Article 78, except Article 101.
note: Commission timeline also states GPAI rules apply and governance must be in place.

milestone: National competent authorities and single points of contact were due.
scope: Member States were to designate responsible market-surveillance authorities and notify the Commission of the single point of contact.
note: Commission list says notifications are being considered and the list is updated continuously.

milestone: Commission proposed the Digital Omnibus on AI Regulation.
scope: Targeted simplification measures affecting AI Act implementation timelines and administrative obligations.
note: The proposal was later adopted; the Commission's proposal page links to the 2026-07-27 entry-into-force announcement.

milestone: High-risk classification guidelines deadline.
scope: Commission guidelines under Article 96 with practical examples of high-risk and non-high-risk AI systems.
note: Official Service Desk page states draft Guidelines were open for consultation until 2026-07-23 before formal adoption.

milestone: Post-market monitoring-plan template implementing act deadline.
scope: Implementing act for a template and list of elements for high-risk AI post-market monitoring plans.
note: Article 72(3) sets this deadline.

milestone: Commission published the final Code of Practice on AI-generated-content marking and labelling.
scope: Voluntary practical steps for Article 50 transparency obligations on generative AI and labelled content.
note: Official page verifies final publication on 10 June 2026 and application of related transparency duties from 2026-08-02.

milestone: AI Omnibus entered into force.
scope: Amendments to AI Act implementation timelines, simplification, new prohibition, sandbox timing and governance/enforcement alignment.
note: Commission page links the full legislative text at https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=OJ:L_202601744.

milestone: General application date for non-deferred rules.
scope: Majority of AI Act rules, including Article 50 transparency obligations and Article 101 GPAI provider fines, except rules deferred by the AI Omnibus.
note: Official timeline states the majority of rules come into force and enforcement starts for applicable rules on this date.

milestone: Legacy high-risk AI significant-change transition date.
scope: Operators of high-risk AI systems, other than Annex X large-scale IT components, placed on the market or put into service before 2026-08-02.
note: Article 111(2) says the Regulation applies to those legacy high-risk systems only if, as from this date, they are subject to significant design changes; public-authority systems have a separate 2030 deadline.

milestone: Original Annex III high-risk application date deferred.
scope: High-risk AI systems listed in Annex III that would otherwise have been covered by the general application date.
note: The Commission's AI Omnibus page confirms Annex III high-risk rules now apply starting 2027-12-02.

milestone: Original national AI regulatory sandbox deadline deferred.
scope: Member State obligation to have at least one operational AI regulatory sandbox.
note: The original Article 57(1) deadline was 2026-08-02; the official timeline now lists 2027-08-02.

milestone: New Omnibus prohibition and Article 50(2) transition apply.
scope: New prohibition for AI systems generating non-consensual sexual deepfakes/CSAM; transition for some providers generating synthetic content placed on the market before 2026-08-02.
note: Official timeline marks this milestone with Digital Omnibus footnote.

milestone: GPAI legacy-model compliance deadline.
scope: Providers of GPAI models placed on the market before 2025-08-02 must comply with GPAI obligations.
note: Article 111(3) transition for existing general-purpose AI models.

milestone: Member State AI regulatory sandboxes operational.
scope: At least one AI regulatory sandbox per Member State.
note: The official timeline says Member States should have at least one AI regulatory sandbox per country operational by this date.

milestone: Original Article 6(1) Annex I high-risk application date deferred.
scope: Article 6(1) high-risk AI embedded in regulated products covered by Annex I.
note: Article 113(c) originally set 2027-08-02; AI Omnibus page confirms Annex I embedded-product rules now apply 2028-08-02.

milestone: Deferred Annex III high-risk AI rules apply.
scope: Rules for high-risk AI systems in Annex III.
note: Official timeline states Annex III high-risk rules apply on 02 Dec 2027 following the Digital Omnibus.

milestone: AI Office evaluation report due.
scope: Commission evaluation of whether the AI Office has sufficient powers, competences, enforcement role and resources.
note: One-off evaluation deadline in Article 112(5).

milestone: Deferred Annex I embedded high-risk AI rules apply.
scope: High-risk AI embedded in regulated products/safety components covered by Annex I.
note: Official timeline states Annex I embedded-product high-risk rules apply on 02 Aug 2028 after the Digital Omnibus.

milestone: First targeted evaluation reports due.
scope: Commission evaluation of possible changes to Annex III area headings, Article 50 transparency measures, and supervision/governance effectiveness.
note: Repeats every four years thereafter.

milestone: GPAI energy-efficient standardisation review due.
scope: Progress report on standardisation deliverables for energy-efficient development of general-purpose AI models and need for further measures.
note: Repeats every four years thereafter.

milestone: Voluntary codes-of-conduct impact review due.
scope: Commission evaluation of voluntary codes of conduct for non-high-risk AI systems, including additional requirements and environmental sustainability.
note: Repeats every three years thereafter.

milestone: Delegated-power report due.
scope: Commission report on the delegation of powers for Articles 6, 7, 11, 43, 47, 51, 52 and 53.
note: Calculated as not later than nine months before the five-year delegation period ending 2029-08-01.

milestone: Deadline to oppose delegated-power tacit extension.
scope: European Parliament or Council opposition to tacit extension of delegated powers.
note: Calculated as not later than three months before the five-year period ends.

milestone: Initial delegated-power period ends or tacitly extends.
scope: Five-year delegation of Commission powers from 2024-08-01.
note: Tacitly extends for identical periods unless opposed.

milestone: General evaluation and review report due.
scope: Commission report evaluating and reviewing the Regulation, including enforcement structure and possible need for a Union agency.
note: Repeats every four years thereafter and reports are public.

milestone: Public-authority high-risk legacy-system compliance deadline.
scope: Providers and deployers of high-risk AI systems intended for public authorities and placed on the market or put into service before 2026-08-02.
note: Article 111(2) transition applies in any case to systems intended to be used by public authorities.

milestone: Large-scale IT-system AI components compliance deadline.
scope: AI systems that are components of large-scale IT systems listed in Annex X and placed on the market or put into service before 2027-08-02.
note: Transitional deadline for Annex X large-scale IT systems.

milestone: Enforcement assessment report due.
scope: Commission assessment of enforcement, with possible amendment proposal on enforcement structure and need for a Union agency.
note: Report goes to Parliament, Council and the European Economic and Social Committee.
